# northflank_secret_group (Resource)

Manages a Northflank project secret group. Secret groups hold environment variables, files, and docker secret mounts that are injected into project services and jobs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: hand off a Terraform-generated database password to a Northflank
# secret group so services in the project can consume it as an env var.

terraform {
  required_providers {
    northflank = {
      source  = "vestmark-infra/northflank"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
    random = {
      source  = "hashicorp/random"
      version = "~> 3.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "northflank" {
  # api_token resolved from NORTHFLANK_API_TOKEN
}

# Generate a random database password with Terraform.
resource "random_password" "db_password" {
  length           = 32
  special          = true
  override_special = "!#$%^&*()-_=+[]{}<>:?"
}

# Hand it off to Northflank as a secret group.
resource "northflank_secret_group" "app_secrets" {
  project_id  = "my-project"
  name        = "App Secrets"
  secret_type = "environment"
  priority    = 10

  variables = {
    DB_PASSWORD = random_password.db_password.result
    DB_HOST     = "db.internal"
    DB_PORT     = "5432"
  }

  files = {
    "/etc/app/config.json" = {
      data     = base64encode("{\"env\": \"production\"}")
      encoding = "utf-8"
    }
  }

  docker_secret_mounts = {
    "tls-cert" = {
      data     = base64encode("--- certificate content ---")
      encoding = "utf-8"
    }
  }
}

# Outputs for cross-module reference.
output "secret_group_id" {
  value       = northflank_secret_group.app_secrets.id
  description = "ID of the Northflank secret group."
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the secret group (3–100 chars; alphanumeric with hyphens or spaces between words).
- `priority` (Number) Merge priority (0–100). Higher value wins when multiple groups define the same key.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project that this secret group belongs to.
- `secret_type` (String) Injection scope. One of: `environment` (Runtime), `arguments` (Build), or `environment-arguments` (Build and Runtime).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the secret group.
- `docker_secret_mounts` (Attributes Map, Sensitive) Docker secret mount contents, encrypted at rest. Keys must be valid Docker secret mount identifiers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--docker_secret_mounts))
- `files` (Attributes Map, Sensitive) Secret files, encrypted at rest. Keys must be absolute file paths (e.g. `/etc/app/config.json`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `restrictions` (Attributes) Controls which services and jobs can access this secret group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restrictions))
- `stage_id` (String) Environment (stage) this secret group is associated with. The Northflank GET endpoint does not return this field, so Terraform preserves the configured value across refreshes.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags attached to the secret group.
- `type` (String) Hierarchy type. One of `secret` (default) or `config` (plaintext config values).
- `variables` (Map of String, Sensitive) Environment variable key/value pairs. Values are encrypted at rest. Keys may only contain letters, numbers, hyphens, forward slashes, and dots.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-generated identifier (derived slug of `name`).

<a id="nestedatt--docker_secret_mounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `docker_secret_mounts`

Required:

- `data` (String) Mount contents, base64-encoded.
- `encoding` (String) Encoding of the mount contents (e.g. `utf-8`).


<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Required:

- `data` (String) File contents, base64-encoded.
- `encoding` (String) Encoding of the file contents (e.g. `utf-8`).


<a id="nestedatt--restrictions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restrictions`

Required:

- `restricted` (Boolean) When `true`, only resources matching `tags` or `nf_objects` have access.

Optional:

- `jobs` (Set of String) IDs of jobs that may access this secret group.
- `services` (Set of String) IDs of services that may access this secret group.
- `tag_match_condition` (String) Whether all tags must match (`and`) or any tag is sufficient (`or`).
- `tags` (Set of String) Restrict access to resources bearing these tags.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing Northflank secret group into Terraform state.
# Format: <project_id>/<secret_group_id>
terraform import northflank_secret_group.app_secrets my-project/app-secrets
```
